rules: 1D bars (18:00 NY roll); daily FVG = three candles whose 1st and 3rd wicks do not overlap (detectors.primitives.fair_value_gaps); all three days need >= 600 M1 bars

first touch: first M1 bar within 13,800 M1 bars (~10 trading days) after the 3rd daily candle closes that trades into the near edge (bullish gap below: low <= gap high); decision = that M1 bar's close; skip if it closes beyond the far edge
swing high above (bullish) / low below (bearish) = extreme of the leg between gap completion and the touch

outcome = 1 if price reaches that extreme (M1 high/low) before any 1h candle closes beyond the gap's far edge, within the next 46 1h candles; else 0 (distances from the touch close, applied from the next M1 open)
null = same two distances, same 46-candle race, at matched random moments (+/-30 d, 5 reps, locked seed) at the same NY time of day (+/-30 min); clustered by gap
